metadata.description: Personal marketplace: a process to design, test and review agent workflows with Claude Code

plugins.name: agent-process
plugins.description: A process for building agent workflows: test rounds with cost and timeline analysis, consistency sweeps over instruction files, and design rules for agent teams.

plugins.name: agent-team
plugins.description: A command that splits a feature into units and builds them with a team of Claude Code agents. One pull request for each unit, units of different repos in parallel.

plugins.name: session-panel
plugins.description: A pane of the open Claude Code sessions: state, last message, reply and approval without entering the session.
